subject: Statistical signficance for path analysis in Blavaan

messages.author: bd79c1ddcc72ffbf
messages.subject: Statistical signficance for path analysis in Blavaan
parts:
Hi all, 
I am doing a path analysis in blavaan. I know how to compare the effect sizes between direct and indirect effects, and I am considering a direct effect to be statistically significant if the posterior credibility interval does not include zero. But I don't know how to assess statistical significance of the indirect effects (the product of multiple effects in a pathway) in blavaan. Any help is greatly appreciated. 

Collin

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: Statistical signficance for path analysis in Blavaan
parts:
I think you will want to extract the posterior samples from your model, then multiply the two path estimates that contribute to the indirect effect, then summarize the resulting posterior distribution. This old post has some code showing how to obtain the posterior samples and how to compute functions of parameters:

https://groups.google.com/g/blavaan/c/iLHxwexpQ14/m/sDaZUcRmBQAJ

Ed
